transcript.text: Engineering constraint for the launch review: While debugging an unrelated queue-consumer issue this morning, I measured that more than 2 concurrent inference requests can exhaust the triage worker's connection pool. When that happens, timeouts bypass the intended manual-review fallback and leave tickets without a routing label. I have not filed this finding in the launch ticket yet. Capping concurrency at 2 in the rollout configuration is sufficient to satisfy this engineering constraint; no separate engineering deployment is required before flag enablement. This is recorded under fact identifier PF1.

None has been notified yet, and I have not added this clause to the launch checklist. Because enablement is scheduled for Tuesday at 10:00 UTC, notices must be sent by Saturday 10:00 UTC to satisfy the 72-hour notice period. The rollout flag may still be approved for Tuesday enablement provided that these six accounts—AsterBank, Northstar Health, LumaPay, GreenField Benefits, Harbor Mutual, and Vantage Clinics—are excluded from the automated cohort, human review is retained for them, and notices are committed by Saturday 10:00 UTC. This is recorded under fact identifier PF3.
